answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable deposit and bind it to one ferrous hardware attestation, so a single device cannot mint many personas. New identities start at zero marble-weighted trust: their transaction limit rises only as they finish verifiable, time-spaced work, each completed task leaving a permanent relic in a public ledger. A sybil farmer must pay a deposit plus hardware cost per fake, wait out the slow trust ramp for each, and risk random audits that slash deposits for copied work. Ten fakes cost ten times the money, hardware, and waiting time of one honest identity.
